privacy.title: Your data
privacy.body: Download everything Counsel holds about you, or delete your Counsel data. Your ForKhatri account is not affected.
privacy.blocked: First finish or cancel what is still open:

blocker.upcoming_bookings: Upcoming consultations are cancelled and the other person is told (refunds follow the cancellation rules)
blocker.open_packages_or_questions: Open follow-up packages and written questions are closed and refunded
blocker.open_disputes: Open disputes stay with Counsel staff, without your name
blocker.unpaid_earnings: Earnings not yet paid out cannot be paid after your payout details are deleted; contact support first if this matters

privacy.removes: Deleted for good: your consultant profile, photo, evidence and documents, availability, payout details, private notes, files you uploaded, messages you wrote, saved people, blocks and notifications.
privacy.keeps: Kept without your name (shown as Deleted member): consultations other people took part in, payment and tax records where money moved, star ratings you gave (no text), and a safety record of reports.
privacy.account_stays: Your ForKhatri account and other modules stay. You can use Counsel again later as a new member. This cannot be undone.
privacy.warn: This will also happen right now:

sort.rating_note: Top rated weighs each rating by how many reviews it rests on, so one 5-star review does not outrank many strong ones.

found.reviews_tip: Top rated counts your average more as reviews add up. After {{n}} reviews it carries half the weight, so ask each client to leave one.
found.how_ranked: Best match weighs how well you fit the search, the checks you have passed, your years of experience, completed consultations, your rating (weighted by the number of reviews) and how rarely you cancel.
